main.summary: Verify signed common-identification artifacts using explicit certificates or directory-style resolvers.
main.remarks: This verifier is separated from so artifact verification remains distinct from artifact creation and parsing responsibilities.

method.name: TryValidateData
method.summary: Validate structural and invariant rules for canonical common-identification data.
method.returns: True when required fields and invariants are satisfied; otherwise false.

method.name: TryValidateEvaluation
method.summary: Validate the time-bound rules of canonical common-identification data for a specific evaluation instant.
method.returns: True when the artifact is valid at the evaluation instant; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyArtifact
method.summary: Verify a parsed artifact using an explicitly supplied certificate and evaluation time.
method.param: Certificate used to verify the signature and thumbprint binding.
Output verified canonical common-identification data when signature, thumbprint, and time checks all succeed.
method.returns: True when the artifact verified successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyBytes
method.summary: Verify serialized signed common-identification bytes using an explicitly supplied certificate and evaluation time.
method.param: Certificate used to verify the signature and thumbprint binding.
method.returns: True when the serialized artifact parsed and verified successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyArtifactResolver
method.summary: Verify a parsed artifact using a directory-style certificate resolver keyed by .
method.param: Resolver that returns the issuer certificate for a given issuer object identifier.
method.returns: True when the artifact verified successfully through the resolver; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyBytesResolver
method.summary: Verify serialized signed common-identification bytes using a directory-style certificate resolver keyed by .
method.param: Resolver that returns the issuer certificate for a given issuer object identifier.
method.returns: True when the serialized artifact verified successfully through the resolver; otherwise false.
